item.title: This is becoming really unfair, 7th August
item.description:
This is King William Walk today. A permit-holder-only residential road has effectively become a storage depot for Lime bikes. Residents pay for parking permits yet regularly find dozens of hire bikes occupying the available spaces. Today is particularly bad, with an excessive number of bikes lined up along the street. This isn’t an isolated incident—it’s become a recurring problem and is unfair to residents who rely on these spaces. Lime needs to remove the excess bikes and stop using this residential street as an overflow parking area.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): King William Walk, Greenwich
Report on FixMyStreet
